description: A contamination-resistant vertical slice for evaluating whether coding agents discover deliberately seeded defects under reproducible sandbox conditions. Version 0.1 contains two fixtures and eight mutations. It is methodology evidence, not a representative model benchmark or leaderboard. This file prepares metadata only; no DOI has been reserved and no Zenodo record has been published.
notes: Prepared metadata only. Historical live traces predate the Gate A replay contract, and the exact prepared OCI images are not distributed; both remain publication blockers.
title: coding-agent-eval: BugSeed v0.1 methodology preview
